task_instance: Starting from a weak baseline template (generic 'Notes'/'Discussion' sections), produce a Granola-optimized meeting-note template for recurring customer calls plus the supporting deliverables the skill calls for: a setup/meeting-practice checklist and a monthly quality-measurement tracker, each following the skill's stated design rules.
evidence: Read SKILL.md. This is an advisory text-authoring skill (allowed-tools: Read, Write, Edit) whose deliverables are plain-text templates, checklists and a tracking sheet; no code execution, binary output or network is required. Created an input baseline_template.md (deliberately weak, using generic 'Notes'/'Discussion' sections). Produced the core deliverable customer_call_template.md and verified it satisfies every Step 3 rule: 6 sections (Summary, Key Decisions, Verbatim Quotes, Open Questions, Action Items, Next Steps) within the 5-7 max; specific section names only (no 'Notes'/'Discussion'); a Verbatim Quotes section because it is a customer call; Action Items placed 5th of 6 (near the end so the AI processes the full meeting first); explicit format hint on each section, including the required action-item format [ - [ ] @person: task (due date) ]. Also produced audio_and_practices_checklist.md (Steps 1, 2, 4) and quality_tracker.csv (Step 6: all five metrics with targets and measurement methods). Files produced in the work directory: baseline_template.md, customer_call_template.md, audio_and_practices_checklist.md, quality_tracker.csv. Verification was a manual check of the finished template against each enumerated rule in the skill; all pass.
